abilities.name: Firebreak Vow
abilities.text: Bjornis treats burning routes as a personal insult and plants himself between the flame front and anyone still breathing.

abilities.name: Smoke Sniffer
abilities.text: Furnace leaks, ember traps, and hidden pressure fires announce themselves to Bjornis before the rest of the squad sees the glow.

abilities.name: Cinder Hug
abilities.text: When panic breaks a line, Bjornis can turn one terrified retreat into a braced stand with a soot-blackened bear hug.

abilities.name: Foam and Fury
abilities.text: His suppression rig hisses cold sealant across hot iron, then he charges through the steam with both paws raised.
